LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 12.3.1 PHRASAL VERBS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.3: Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs, part of Strand 12 in Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How are phrasal verbs formed? 2. How can one tell the meaning of a phrasal verb?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read a text and isolate the phrasal verbs formed from make, pass and look,

2. search the internet for more examples of the given phrasal verbs and list them on different flash cards,

3. work with peers to construct sentences on modern fashion using the given phrasal verbs,

4. use print and digital dictionaries of phrasal verbs to check the meaning of the given phrasal verbs, with peers. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read a text and isolate the phrasal verbs formed from make, pass and look,
2. search the internet for more examples of the given phrasal verbs and list them on different flash cards,
3. work with peers to construct sentences on modern fashion using the given phrasal verbs,
4. use print and digital dictionaries of phrasal verbs to check the meaning of the given phrasal verbs, with peers. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication: It is enhanced as the learner learns to speak clearly and effectively through correct use of phrasal verbs.

• Digital literacy: It is developed as the learner checks the meanings of phrasal verbs from digital dictionaries.

Values:
Unity: It is promoted as the learner makes contributions in group activities.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Cultural awareness: It is promoted as the learner constructs sentences on modern fashion.
